source.note: heirNoiseBoundLog2 is HEIR's own noise.bound annotation (its model), informational

noiseDerivation.errorBoundSource: Lattigo v6.1.0 DefaultXe: sigma 3.2, Bound 19.2 (core/rlwe/security.go:10-17), hard rejection v <= 19.2 then rounding, so |e| <= 19 (ring/sampler_gaussian.go:160-166); HEIR emits no Xe/Xs (LattigoEmitter.cpp:1992-2010)
noiseDerivation.msbForm: Lattigo BGV keeps ct phase = m*t^-1 + e (encoder.go:376-377); all bounds here are for the LSB view Phi = t*phase = m + t*e
noiseDerivation.inputNoiseFormula: (t-1) + t*floor((2*Be*(2N+1) + (N+1)*(p0-1))/(2*p0)) with p0 = 2147721217: Lattigo public-key encryption mod Q*p0 then centred division by p0 (encryptor.go:172-260); m lifted to [0,t) (encoder.go:218-222,361)
noiseDerivation.keyNoiseFormula: t*Be: Lattigo keys carry plain e in MSB form (keygenerator.go:296-310), i.e. t*e in the LSB view
noiseDerivation.keySwitchingVariant: centred: Lattigo ModUp is exact and centred (|d_j| <= Q_j/2, ring/basis_extension.go:401-435,498-525) and ModDown is an exact centred rounding (|r| <= 1/2, basis_extension.go:222-256); so its LSB-view error, at most t*(N*Be*sum_j Q_j/2 + P*(1+N)/2)/P, is below the centred reference bound ksBoundAt and hence below the canonical one used here (ASSUMED match, argued from source, not proved)
